name: Solar Providence draws a card, then discards a card
notes: Solar Providence's element is FIRE, matching the starting champion, so no lineage patch is needed. Without a [Class Bonus] discount, the full 2-reserve cost is paid, then both players decline the EffectStackActiveResponse opportunity window before the ability's own draw (unconditional) and discard MZCHOOSE decision resolve. The [Kongming Bonus] Shifting Currents / damage clause is out of scope.

rulesClauses: Draw a card, then discard a card.
